designer_intent.description: Create a cinematic, hook-heavy West Coast Hip-Hop instrumental arrangement with an emphasis on sample-based textures and rhythmically sliced one-shot hits. Preserve energy flow with well-defined sections and clear transitions.

presetor_intent.description: Provide presets optimized for sample slicing techniques with dynamic control and cinematic spatial effects supporting the energetic hooks.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythm patterns using sample slicing techniques to create tight, punchy drum hits fitting the West Coast Hip-Hop style.

bass_generator.brief: Produce a groove-focused bassline emphasizing foundational low frequencies that complement the sample layers and rhythmic elements.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange harmonic content as sample-based chords providing cinematic atmosphere without overpowering the percussion or bass.

melody_generator.brief: Develop textural melodic elements using samples and subtle modulation to enhance the cinematic mood without traditional lead lines.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee overall arrangement ensuring energy curve matches hook-heavy structure and smooth transitions between sections.

presetor.brief: Configure effects and preset parameters to support sample-based textures and dynamic drum hits with spatial and transient processing.

songgps.brief: Map arrangement sections and energy flow consistent with the West Coast Hip-Hop cinematic instrumental theme.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix with focus on clarity and punch, preserving dynamics of one-shot hits and richness of sample beds.
